saw_lines: Fragrance buyers rarely test a bottle online. They pick a scent they already trust, then reorder or gift it.
So the sale is lost in the first line, where a scroller who sees no scent or offer keeps moving.
Your 17 ads with written copy carry no proof number, so new buyers have nothing to trust. Collect one review count and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 16 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 17 ads with written copy carry a proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete to weigh. Collect one real figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and open three new ads with it on the creative.

6 Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so a cold viewer has to search for the scent that caught their eye. Point each at the single fragrance it features, such as the Absolu Vanilla or Noble Eclat page.
0 of 17 ads carry an offer or discount, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Add one first order offer or the Autumn Aura kit bundle to three new ads and write it on the creative.
24 ads have run 60 days or more, yet none of your 6 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Those winners already show the angle works. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest one.
